scope: Architecture inventory only. Maps every factual concept currently found anywhere in the repository (Phases 1A-1D field/concept/entity catalogs) to its destination in schemas/name-entity.schema.json. No dataset, generator, or HTML was modified to produce this file.
method: Built by cross-referencing audit/entity-map.json (Phase 1A), audit/knowledge-coverage.json (Phase 1B), audit/assertion-catalog.json (Phase 1C), and audit/knowledge-roi.json (Phase 1D) against the domain structure defined in schemas/name-entity.schema.json. Every source field/concept in those four reports appears exactly once below (see audit/schema-validation.json for the completeness check).
